# `react/CompactCell`

The grid mode's tile: its own scope, its own timeframe chips, its own remove button, and
nothing else. It mounts a chart of its own through the same engine seam the main surface uses.

## Example

```ts
import { DEFAULT_COMPACT_CELL_LABELS, type CompactCellLabels } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

export const labels: CompactCellLabels = { ...DEFAULT_COMPACT_CELL_LABELS, empty: 'sem barras' };
```

## `CompactCellProps`

changes in the code changes here.

| `timeframes` | `readonly string[]` | yes | — |
| `onTimeframe` | `(timeframe: string) => void` | yes | — |

| `testIdPrefix` | `string \| undefined` | no | `'compact-cell'` |
